clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa7_association_analysis: For participants with PD, deviations (z scores) from the normative models were tested for significance against a null distribution using t-tests (alpha = 0.05). Correlations between deviation scores and disease duration/cognitive scores were also tested. Multiple comparisons were corrected using Benjamini-Hochberg or Bonferroni-Holm.
clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa8_key_findings_brief: Patients with Parkinson's disease showed significant deviations from normal age-related patterns of brain function-neurotransmitter colocalization, and the magnitude of deviation in the GABAergic system correlated with disease duration.
clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa9_key_findings_detailed: In patients with PD, colocalization patterns significantly deviated from age- and sex-adjusted normative models across various neurotransmitter systems. Deviations in local activity (fALFF) were found for serotonergic, GABA, and glutamatergic systems. Deviations in connectivity (LCOR/GCOR) were also present for dopamine systems. The deviation in colocalization strength of LCOR with GABAA receptors was negatively correlated with disease duration (Pearson's r = -0.38, pFDR = .027).

caa10_key_limitations.answer: PD severity was only approximated by disease duration; Medication effects were not controlled for; UK Biobank has a healthy volunteer bias; PET maps were from heterogeneous populations.
caa10_key_limitations.supporting_text: Because no scores for PD severity... and only a limited number of cognitive scores were available, we could only roughly approximate PD severity based on disease duration. Because PD medication is known to affect measures of brain function, it might have contributed to some of the effects observed... Additional healthy control biases in the UK Biobank (92) include a high average socioeconomic status and low alcohol and tobacco consumption... Using PET maps from differently aged healthy populations might have introduced a further bias...

clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa11_application_notes: The study proposes that the strength of colocalization between brain functional measures and neurotransmitter maps can be used as a sensitive measure of neurodegeneration, offering insights into underlying neuropathological processes.

general_note_part.gn1_general_notes: A novel aspect of this study is the application of normative modeling to the spatial correlation between rs-fMRI measures and PET-derived neurotransmitter maps, rather than to the imaging measures directly. This allows for an investigation into the neurochemical underpinnings of age- and disease-related brain changes.
